rationale: graph::render iterates each stored reference once and emits its labeled SVG edge; explicit leases use edge_target to find a named supporting slot junction, whereas object-targeting edges end at the target rectangle left boundary. Labels and the SVG description use escape; lib::render preserves the authored facts in an alternate Facts pane. Deterministic node order and first-discovered owning depth produce repeatable layout, with cycles/disconnected nodes still renderable. The cited tests check edge counts/kinds, junctions, retained facts and deterministic cyclic/self-loop layouts.
limitations: Layout does not prove ownership well-formedness or synthesize provenance. The unit appropriately qualifies placement by graph structure.
